stem: Which sentence from the selection best explains why some people may prefer human-to-human communication?

options.label: A
options.text: Despite the efficiency of these systems, many people find them impersonal, stilted, and sometimes frustrating.

options.label: B
options.text: Even the advanced human-machine interfaces used today are unable to trick the judge consistently into thinking a computer is a human.

options.label: C
options.text: Simply put, the reason is that human beings rely on more than words to produce utterances and derive meaning from them.

options.label: D
options.text: While the potential for spontaneous communication between a human and a machine may seem exciting, this possibility concerns some people.
